# hiok_app_registration (Resource)

An app that signs people in with their HIOK account (OpenID Connect, authorization code + PKCE). Issuer: <endpoint>/api/hiok-id/oidc. The secret is only in state from creation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Exact redirect URIs (https, or http://localhost).

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `homepage_url` (String)
- `secret_expires_in_days` (Number) Lifetime of the client secret (1–730 days).
- `sign_in_audience` (String) directory (people in this account's HIOK ID) or any (every HIOK account).

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Shown once, at creation.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
